stops.stop: Buenos Aires, MavePay at Ekoparty
stops.date_confidence: attested talk, contested venue. The Full Disclosure announcement at seclists.org/fulldisclosure/2012/Sep/30 gives the eighth Ekoparty, trainings 17 to 18 September and conference 19 to 21 September 2012, lists Bitcoin, MavePay and the Future of Cryptocurrencies on the program, and gives the location only as Ciudad Autonoma de Buenos Aires. The frequent claim that 2012 was Ekoparty's tenth-anniversary edition is wrong: Spanish Wikipedia and the program itself both make it the eighth. The MAVEPAY paper PDF carries a creation date of 17 April 2012 and a single author.
